title: The Signature Was Gone By Morning

scenes.text: I SIGNED FOR IT. IT'S BACK.
scenes.narration: Last night I signed my wallet out of lost property, and took it home. This morning it was back on the shelf.
scenes.imagePrompt: A worn brown leather wallet back on a steel shelf in a wire mesh cage, its brown luggage tag hanging from it, morning light from a high window, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: My signature had gone from the log. Not crossed out. The claimed by line was empty again.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up of a ledger column with a single empty ruled line between lines of faded handwriting, no ink on it at all, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: THE ONE AT HOME IS STILL THERE
scenes.narration: I rang home. The one I took last night is still on the hall table. There are two of them now.
scenes.imagePrompt: A brown leather wallet on a small hall table beside a front door at night, a dim lamp on, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: Nothing in this room is ever collected. I am starting to think the log does not allow it. Not by me, anyway.
